rules.title: The new dates and amounts have the number formats of the existing rows
rules.detail: 6 of 6 new rows are not formatted like the existing rows: row 17 (Train ticket #1) has Date 'General', Amount 'General'; row 18 (Client lunch #2) has Date 'General', Amount 'General'; row 19 (Paper and pens #3) has Date 'General', Amount 'General' (and 3 more). In expenses.xlsx as given, the existing rows have Date 'yyyy\-mm\-dd', Amount '#,##0.00' (formats count as the same when they differ only in letter case, quotes or backslash escapes, a text section that is only '@', a zero section equal to the first, a negative section of '-' and a first section of digits such as #,##0.00;-#,##0.00 (it shows -0.00 instead of 0.00 only for a negative number that rounds to zero, and the task's amounts are all positive), or a locale tag such as [$-409] on a date of digits; under such a tag an unquoted '/' counts as the date separator LibreOffice 24.2 shows for it: [$-41D]yyyy/mm/dd shows 2024-03-02, [$-409]yyyy/mm/dd 2024/03/02 and [$-407]yyyy/mm/dd 2024.03.02).

rules.title: Every Summary total (category, month, grand total) includes the new expenses
